findings.title: Tool-terminal receipt ownership can be borrowed across query rows
findings.cause: Global httpTools Map overwrites by tool ID. All SDK query rows compare against the final aggregate map, so a broken/missing own terminal can borrow another response with the same ID and canonical arguments. Exact per-request adapter matching does not correct this separate receipt map.
findings.requiredCorrection: Reject SDK tool IDs reused across different query rows and HTTP IDs repeated across terminals, or correlate ownership explicitly. Retain same-query tools/input/owned outside-write conditions.
findings.negativeControl: Synthetic two query rows reuse one ID/arguments, second own HTTP terminal omitted; reject despite another valid matching terminal.
findings.status: accepted by root; owner correction in progress; not yet independently verified at a stable replacement head

findings.title: Malformed SDK result flags accepted as canonical
findings.cause: Observer coerces missing/nonboolean is_error to false; max-turns exception does not require true. Thus success with absent/nonboolean flag or error_max_turns with false/missing flag can qualify with otherwise complete model/usage/tool facts.
findings.requiredCorrection: Record valid boolean flag and require success false or error_max_turns true, alongside existing one-turn cap/num-turn/terminal-reason/tool-terminal checks.
findings.negativeControl: Missing success is_error and false/missing error_max_turns is_error must fail nativeReceipts while valid JSON/SSE max-turns controls stay positive.
findings.status: accepted by root; owner correction in progress; not yet independently verified at a stable replacement head

findings.title: silent true suppresses actual decision records required by the harness
findings.cause: Actual server.ts:683 sets proxyLogSilent from config.silent; plog at562 suppresses console output, including requestLogLine at2984. Harness console interception receives no real decisions when startProxyServer(silent:true), while synthetic server ignores silent and prints anyway. Native gate would fail all request-decision assertions after costly calls.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use silent false within established contained console interception. Synthetic target must assert or honor the real silent behavior so this integration assumption is discriminated.
findings.negativeControl: Fixture mirrors actual silent contract; corrected harness must supply false. Static direct caller/callee inspection establishes cause; no native query was run.
findings.status: accepted by root; owner correction in progress; not yet independently verified at a stable replacement head

findings.title: Late result write can mutate a linked target after invariance was asserted
findings.cause: Private real output directory is checked, but existing result filename may be a symlink/hardlink. Final write follows target/grant invariance checks and follows that link, permitting own harness write to destroy a target after proof.targetIdentityUnchanged was true.
findings.requiredCorrection: Reserve result as exclusive owned file before any invocation, hold descriptor, validate private regular/single-link ownership and write via that held descriptor; existing output must be rejected.
findings.negativeControl: Zero-query existing-output symlink (and hardlink where useful) is rejected; unrelated target bytes unchanged. Do not create unsafe links to real owner stores in the test.
findings.status: accepted by root; owner correction in progress; not yet independently verified at a stable replacement head

findings.title: SSE max-turns receipt accepts missing start/out-of-order terminal frames
findings.cause: Validator separately tracks stopped, reason and closed booleans; it can accept no message_start or message_stop before tool closure/terminal delta. That is not the complete ordered terminal needed by the exception.
findings.requiredCorrection: Require message start, closed complete tool blocks before tool_use terminal delta, then message stop; reject subsequent content/tool/error frames. Scope this to bounded necessary receipt order rather than claiming full Anthropic grammar validation.
findings.negativeControl: Missing message_start and stop-before-tool-closure/delta must fail nativeReceipts while normal JSON/SSE capped-tool receipts remain accepted.
findings.status: accepted by root; owner correction in progress; not yet independently verified at a stable replacement head
